ShapeEngine
Table of Contents

Class StripedDrawing

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.StripedDrawingDef
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides static methods for drawing striped patterns inside various geometric shapes, including support for excluding regions defined by other shapes.

DrawGeneratedSegments(Segments, LineDrawingInfo)

Draws every segment in Segments using the provided LineDrawingInfo.

public static void DrawGeneratedSegments(this Segments segments, LineDrawingInfo info)

Parameters

segments Segments

The segments collection to render.

info LineDrawingInfo

Line drawing parameters applied to each segment.

DrawGeneratedSegments(Segments, LineDrawingInfo, LineDrawingInfo)

Draws the given Segments using two alternating LineDrawingInfo instances. The first segment uses striped, the second uses alternatingStriped, and the pattern repeats for the remaining segments.

public static void DrawGeneratedSegments(this Segments segments, LineDrawingInfo striped, LineDrawingInfo alternatingStriped)

Parameters

segments Segments

The collection of segments to render.

striped LineDrawingInfo

Line drawing parameters applied to even-indexed segments (0-based).

alternatingStriped LineDrawingInfo

Line drawing parameters applied to odd-indexed segments.

DrawGeneratedSegments(Segments, params LineDrawingInfo[])

Draws the given Segments using a repeating sequence of LineDrawingInfo instances supplied in alternatingInfo. The segment at index i uses alternatingInfo[i % alternatingInfo.Length].

public static void DrawGeneratedSegments(this Segments segments, params LineDrawingInfo[] alternatingInfo)

Parameters

segments Segments

The collection of segments to render.

alternatingInfo LineDrawingInfo[]

One or more LineDrawingInfo instances used in round-robin order. Must contain at least one element.

DrawStriped(Circle, CurveFloat, float, LineDrawingInfo)

Draws a striped pattern inside the specified shape.

public static void DrawStriped(this Circle circle, CurveFloat spacingCurve, float angleDeg, LineDrawingInfo striped)

Parameters

circle Circle

The shape for drawing the striped pattern inside.

spacingCurve CurveFloat

The curve to determine the spacing along the shape. The value of each key has to be bigger than 0, otherwise the function will return early!

angleDeg float

The angle of the striped pattern. 0 degrees would be vertical lines, 90 degrees would be horizontal lines.

striped LineDrawingInfo

The line drawing info for how the lines should be drawn.

DrawStriped(Circle, CurveFloat, float, LineDrawingInfo, LineDrawingInfo)

Draws an alternating striped pattern inside the specified shape.

public static void DrawStriped(this Circle circle, CurveFloat spacingCurve, float angleDeg, LineDrawingInfo striped, LineDrawingInfo alternatingStriped)

Parameters

circle Circle

The shape for drawing the striped pattern inside.

spacingCurve CurveFloat

The curve to determine the spacing along the shape. The value of each key has to be bigger than 0, otherwise the function will return early!

angleDeg float

The angle of the striped pattern. 0 degrees would be vertical lines, 90 degrees would be horizontal lines.

striped LineDrawingInfo

The first line drawing info for drawing even lines.

alternatingStriped LineDrawingInfo

The second line drawing info for drawing odd lines.

DrawStriped(Circle, CurveFloat, float, params LineDrawingInfo[])

Draws an alternating striped pattern inside the specified shape.

public static void DrawStriped(this Circle circle, CurveFloat spacingCurve, float angleDeg, params LineDrawingInfo[] alternatingStriped)

Parameters

circle Circle

The shape for drawing the striped pattern inside.

spacingCurve CurveFloat

The curve to determine the spacing along the shape. The value of each key has to be bigger than 0, otherwise the function will return early!

angleDeg float

DrawStriped(Circle, Circle, float, float, LineDrawingInfo, float)

Draws a striped pattern inside the outside shape without drawing in the inside shape. The inside shape does not have to be completely inside the outside shape.

public static void DrawStriped(this Circle outsideShape, Circle insideShape, float spacing, float angleDeg, LineDrawingInfo striped, float spacingOffset = 0)

Parameters

outsideShape Circle

The shape for drawing the striped pattern inside.

insideShape Circle

The shape to not draw any striped pattern inside.

spacing float

How far apart the lines are.

angleDeg float

The angle of the striped pattern. 0 degrees would be vertical lines, 90 degrees would be horizontal lines.

striped LineDrawingInfo

The line drawing info for how the lines should be drawn.

spacingOffset float

An offset for the spacing between 0 and 1. Can be used for a continuously moving pattern.

public static void DrawStriped(this Rect outsideShape, Quad insideShape, float spacing, float angleDeg, LineDrawingInfo striped, float spacingOffset = 0)

Parameters

outsideShape Rect

The shape for drawing the striped pattern inside.

insideShape Quad

The shape to not draw any striped pattern inside.

spacing float

How far apart the lines are.

angleDeg float

The angle of the striped pattern. 0 degrees would be vertical lines, 90 degrees would be horizontal lines.

striped LineDrawingInfo

The line drawing info for how the lines should be drawn.

spacingOffset float

An offset for the spacing between 0 and 1. Can be used for a continuously moving pattern.

DrawStripedRing(Vector2, float, float, float, LineDrawingInfo, LineDrawingInfo, float)

Draw an alternating striped ring. Draws lines across the circumference of the ring. Each line starts on the inner radius and ends on the outer radius.

public static void DrawStripedRing(Vector2 center, float innerRadius, float outerRadius, float angleSpacingDeg, LineDrawingInfo striped, LineDrawingInfo alternatingStriped, float angleOffset = 0)

Parameters

center Vector2

The center of the ring.

innerRadius float

The inner radius of the ring. Should be positive and smaller than the outer radius.

outerRadius float

The outer radius of the ring. Should be positive and bigger than the inner radius.

angleSpacingDeg float

The spacing between each line in degrees.

striped LineDrawingInfo

The first line drawing info for drawing even lines.

alternatingStriped LineDrawingInfo

The second line drawing info for drawing odd lines.

angleOffset float

The start offset. Value is wrapped between 0 and 1 and multiplied with the angleSpacingDeg. So the min offset is zero and the max offset is angleSpacingDeg!

GenerateStripedRing(Vector2, float, float, float, float)

Generates a collection of radial segments that form a striped ring. Each segment starts at the ring's inner radius and ends at the outer radius, positioned at evenly spaced angles around the specified center.

public static Segments GenerateStripedRing(Vector2 center, float innerRadius, float outerRadius, float angleSpacingDeg, float angleOffset = 0)

Parameters

center Vector2

Center point of the ring.

innerRadius float

Inner radius of the ring. Negative values are clamped to zero; if greater than outerRadius values are swapped.

outerRadius float

Outer radius of the ring. Negative values are clamped to zero.

angleSpacingDeg float

Angular spacing in degrees between consecutive lines. Must be greater than zero.

angleOffset float

Normalized offset in the range [0,1) applied to the starting angle as a fraction of angleSpacingDeg (default 0).

Returns

Segments

A Segments collection containing the generated radial segments.

GenerateStripedRing(Vector2, float, float, float, float, float, float)

Generates radial segments for a sector of a striped ring between two angles. Each segment runs from innerRadius to outerRadius at evenly spaced angles determined by angleSpacingDeg.

public static Segments GenerateStripedRing(Vector2 center, float innerRadius, float outerRadius, float angleSpacingDeg, float minAngleDeg, float maxAngleDeg, float angleOffset = 0)

Parameters

center Vector2

Center point of the ring.

innerRadius float

Inner radius of the ring. Negative values are clamped to zero; if greater than outerRadius values are swapped.

outerRadius float

Outer radius of the ring. Negative values are clamped to zero.

angleSpacingDeg float

Angular spacing in degrees between consecutive lines. Must be greater than zero.

minAngleDeg float

Start angle of the sector in degrees.

maxAngleDeg float

End angle of the sector in degrees.

angleOffset float

Normalized offset in the range [0,1) applied to the starting angle as a fraction of angleSpacingDeg (default 0).

Returns

Segments

A Segments collection containing the generated radial segments.

GenerateStripedSegments(Circle, CurveFloat, float)

Generates a collection of line segments representing a striped pattern clipped to the specified circle, where the distance between consecutive stripes is determined by a CurveFloat.

public static Segments GenerateStripedSegments(this Circle circle, CurveFloat spacingCurve, float angleDeg)

Parameters

circle Circle

The circle to populate with striped segments.

spacingCurve CurveFloat

A curve that defines the spacing along the pattern. The curve must have keys and sampled values must be > 0; otherwise the method returns an empty result.

angleDeg float

Orientation of the stripes in degrees (0 = vertical, 90 = horizontal).

Returns

Segments

A Segments instance containing segments that lie inside the circle.

GenerateStripedSegments(Circle, float, float, float)

circle Circle

angleDeg float

spacingOffset float

Normalized offset in the range [0,1] used to shift the pattern (useful for animation).

Returns

Segments

A Segments instance containing segments that lie inside the circle.

GenerateStripedSegments<T>(Circle, T, float, float, float)

Generates striped segments clipped to the given outside circle while excluding the area of an inside shape. The method casts parallel lines/rays across the outside circle and subtracts intersections with the provided inside shape to produce the final visible stripe segments.

public static Segments GenerateStripedSegments<T>(this Circle outsideShape, T insideShape, float spacing, float angleDeg, float spacingOffset = 0)

Parameters

outsideShape Circle

Circle that defines the outer boundary for the stripes.

insideShape T

Shape to be excluded from the stripes.

spacing float

Distance between adjacent stripes. Values = 0 will produce an empty result.

angleDeg float

Orientation of the stripes in degrees (0 = vertical, 90 = horizontal).

spacingOffset float

Normalized offset in the range [0,1] used to shift the pattern (useful for animation).

Returns

Segments

A Segments instance containing segments that lie inside outsideShape but outside insideShape.

Type Parameters

T

Type of the inside shape. Allowed types are handled inside the method. Supported inside shape types: Triangle, Circle, Rect, Quad, Polygon.

Generates striped segments clipped to the given outside quad while excluding the area of an inside shape. The method casts parallel lines/rays across the outside quad and subtracts intersections with the provided inside shape to produce the final visible stripe segments.

public static Segments GenerateStripedSegments<T>(this Quad outsideShape, T insideShape, float spacing, float angleDeg, float spacingOffset = 0)

Parameters

outsideShape Quad

Quad that defines the outer boundary for the stripes.

insideShape T

Shape to be excluded from the stripes.

spacing float

Distance between adjacent stripes. Values = 0 will produce an empty result.

angleDeg float

Orientation of the stripes in degrees (0 = vertical, 90 = horizontal).

spacingOffset float

Normalized offset in the range [0,1] used to shift the pattern (useful for animation).

Returns

Segments

A Segments instance containing segments that lie inside outsideShape but outside insideShape.

Type Parameters

T

Type of the inside shape. Allowed types are handled inside the method. Supported inside shape types: Triangle, Circle, Rect, Quad, Polygon.

GenerateStripedSegments<TO, TI>(TO, TI, float, float, float)

Generates striped segments for an outer shape while optionally excluding areas covered by an inner shape. The method dispatches to specific overloads for supported shape types (Circle, Triangle, Rectangle, Quad, Polygon).

public static Segments GenerateStripedSegments<TO, TI>(TO outsideShape, TI insideShape, float spacing, float angleDeg, float spacingOffset = 0)

Parameters

outsideShape TO

The outer shape to fill with stripe lines.

insideShape TI

The inner shape to exclude from stripes (may be null or of a supported type).

spacing float

Distance between adjacent stripe lines in the same units as shape coordinates.

angleDeg float

Stripe angle in degrees, measured from the x-axis.

spacingOffset float

Optional offset to shift the stripe pattern along its perpendicular direction.

Returns

Segments

A Segments collection containing the generated stripe segments; may be empty if no stripes are produced.

Type Parameters

TO

Type of the outside shape. Only allowed shapes are: Circle, Triangle, Rect, Quad, Polygon).

TI

Type of the inside (excluded) shape. Only allowed shapes are: Circle, Triangle, Rect, Quad, Polygon).
